eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Optical Communication, Photonics, Telecommunications, and Intelligent Machine Applications (OPTIMA-2026) aims to provide a premier international platform for researchers, academicians, industry experts, and innovators to present and discuss recent advances in photonics, artificial intelligence, and next-generation communication technologies.  The conference focuses on theoretical developments, experimental research, industrial applications, and emerging trends in optical communication systems, photonic devices, intelligent network architectures, and AI-driven communication frameworks. It encourages interdisciplinary contributions that integrate photonics with machine learning, quantum technologies, edge–cloud systems, and intelligent automation.
